scorecard.name: Hold time and Dead Air
scorecard.coaching: The agent left two unmanaged dead-air gaps exceeding 30 seconds at [05:19] (43s) and [12:57] (54s) without properly announcing a hold or thanking the customer for waiting upon return.

scorecard.name: Verified customer
scorecard.coaching: The agent ran line diagnostics first and failed to verify the customer's address and security PIN within the mandatory first 240 seconds, only requesting verification at [06:12].

scorecard.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
scorecard.coaching: When the customer expressed frustration at [00:41] about his broadband dropping during work and later complained about dead air at [05:35], the agent never apologized or acknowledged his frustration.

scorecard.name: Paraphrasing
scorecard.coaching: After the customer explained the landline static and VDSL drop-on-ring fault at [00:10], the agent jumped directly into line testing without paraphrasing or restating the issue.

scorecard.name: Active listening
scorecard.coaching: At [10:15], the agent asked if the customer had tried unscrewing the master socket faceplate and plugging into the test socket, ignoring that the customer had already stated he did this at [01:08].

scorecard.name: Probing
scorecard.coaching: Between [00:55] and [05:19], the agent relied entirely on automated line telemetry and failed to ask diagnostic probing questions about microfilters, extension sockets, or weather correlation.

scorecard.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
scorecard.coaching: As confirmed at [16:00], the physical copper line fault and landline static remain unresolved pending the Openreach linesman visit on Friday morning.

grader.scenario: Loud static crackling on copper landline and VDSL broadband dropping sync every time an incoming phone call rings
grader.notes: Poor call with 7 FAILs (H, V, E, PA, AL, PR, RE) and 4 PASSes (B, P, O, R). Agent Craig uses proper branding ([00:00], [17:37]), addresses Zlatan by name, remains polite under criticism ([13:27], R PASS), and takes strong ownership by applying a 12dB noise-margin stability profile, setting up free exchange call divert to prevent incoming ring spikes, and booking Openreach engineer OR-6619482-SK ([00:28]–[16:47], O PASS). However, Craig delays security verification until [06:12] (>240s, V FAIL), leaves two unmanaged dead-air gaps at [05:19] (43s) and [12:57] (54s) (H FAIL), never apologizes or shows empathy (E FAIL), never paraphrases (PA FAIL), asks zero diagnostic questions about microfilters or extension wiring (PR FAIL), asks about the test socket at [10:15] after Zlatan already told him at [01:08] (AL FAIL), and the physical fault awaits Friday's Openreach visit ([16:00], RE FAIL).

items.name: Branding and Survey Check
items.evidence: [00:00] Agent: 'Good afternoon, thank you for calling S-Net Technical Support.' and [17:37] Agent: 'Thank you for choosing S-Net, Zlatan...'

items.name: Hold time and Dead Air
items.evidence: Two unmanaged gaps >30s: before [05:19] (43s gap, Customer complains at [05:35]) and before [12:57] (54s gap, Customer complains at [13:12]).

items.name: Verified customer
items.evidence: No PIN/address/security question verification in the first 240 seconds; Agent only asks for address and PIN at [06:12] (>240s into the call).

items.name: Personalized the call/ticket appropriately
items.evidence: [00:28] Agent addresses the customer by name ('Zlatan') throughout the conversation.

items.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
items.evidence: [00:41] Customer expresses severe frustration working from home with a dropping line; Agent responds purely procedurally without a single apology or empathy statement.

items.name: Paraphrasing
items.evidence: [00:28]–[00:55] Agent moves straight into running line telemetry without summarizing the customer's reported symptoms.

items.name: Active listening
items.evidence: [01:08] Customer: '...this morning I unscrewed the lower half of the NTE5C master socket faceplate and plugged my corded telephone directly into the internal test port...' -> [10:15] Agent: '...have you tried unscrewing the faceplate on your master socket and plugging the phone into the test socket yet?'

items.name: Took ownership of the problem
items.evidence: [00:28] Agent takes personal ownership; applies a 12dB stability profile, sets up free exchange Call Divert, waives any engineer fee, books Openreach job OR-6619482-SK, and schedules a personal follow-up at [16:47].

items.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
items.evidence: [13:27] Agent remains calm, polite, and respectful even when the customer criticizes the unannounced silences and repeated question.

items.name: Probing
items.evidence: Zero diagnostic questions asked about ADSL/VDSL microfilters, secondary extension sockets, or whether the crackling worsens in wet/windy weather.

items.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
items.evidence: [16:00] Agent: 'Yes, the physical static on the copper pair will remain until the Openreach engineer replaces the corroded dropwire crimp on Friday morning, Zlatan.'
